decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that preserves the holes in both the bushing and sliding mandrel, fully capturing the source decision.
Retaining the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes does not change the specified main-shaft stock, dimensions, keyway, locking-nut thread, or bushing-space width.
The decision to retain existing holes does not alter the bushing material, default part material, or drawing material annotations.
The source decision concerns existing bushing and sliding-mandrel holes and does not change the fabrication sequence or pre-weld finishing of surfaces 1 and 2.
The retained bushing and sliding-mandrel holes are unrelated to the 45-degree orientation between the lug hole axes.
The hole-retention decision supplies design content for affected parts but does not change the independent obligation to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set.
Retaining the holes may inform model geometry, but it does not change the requirement to deliver the 3D shaft assembly model.
The decision about retaining holes does not alter the assembly-based numbering rule for individual drawings.
